Overview

Ponta Delgada is a city in Açores with a population of 46,102. The largest city in the Azores archipelago, with volcanic landscapes, thermal springs, and a historic center on São Miguel Island. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
